page_data.en:
Translation of an article from the "Shun Pao Monthly Magazine",
Volume II, Issue No. 1, dated January 15, 1933.

A STUDY OF THE CIVIC ADMINISTRATION OF THE INTERNATIONAL
SETTLEMENT OF SHANGHAI.

I. Foreword.

Before entering into a study of the civic adminis-
tration of the International Settlement of Shanghai, we must,
first of all, understand the origin of this Settlement.

The International Settlement was established as a
result of the Opium War in 1842, and China, being vanquished,
concluded a Treaty agreeing to open five ports to foreign trade.
Shanghai was one of the five ports mentioned in the Nanking
Treaty. In August 1843 the Taotai of Soo-Tah discussed
with the British Consul the demarkation of boundary lines.
Two years later, the area of the Settlement was extended. At
that time the territory of the Settlement was very small - it
was bounded on the South by the Yangkingpang Creek (At present
Avenue Edward VII), on the East by the Whangpoo River and on
the North by Peking Road. Later, America and France also
sent representations to the Governor of Kwangtung to demand
concessions in Shanghai. Their request was granted and the
French Concession was established in the area extending from
the Yangkingpang Creek to the City Creek (at present Boulevard
des Deux Republiques) and the American Settlement in the
Hongkew District.

During the Taiping Rebellion the Chinese
and foreigners formed a joint defence bureau and
Shanghai Free Militia. The number of Chinese
citizens taking refuge in the Settlement gave
rise to the prosperity of commerce.
page_data.zh:
译自1933年1月15日出版的《申报月刊》第二卷第一期的一篇文章。

上海公共租界市政管理研究。

一、前言。

在着手研究上海公共租界的市政管理之前，我们首先必须了解该租界的起源。

公共租界是1842年鸦片战争的结果而建立的，中国战败后签订条约，同意开放五个口岸进行对外贸易。上海是《南京条约》中提到的五个口岸之一。1843年8月，苏太道台与英国领事讨论了边界线的划定。两年后，租界区域得以扩展。当时租界的领土非常小——南以洋泾浜（现爱多亚路/Avenue Edward VII）为界，东以黄浦江为界，北以北京路为界。后来，美国和法国也向广东总督提出照会，要求在上海获得租界。他们的请求获准，法租界建立在从洋泾浜到城河（现共和双路/Boulevard des Deux Republiques）的区域，美租界则建立在虹口区。

在太平天国运动期间，中外人士组成了联合防御局和上海自由民团。涌入租界避难的中国公民人数众多，促进了商业的繁荣。

page_data.en:
- 2 -
of the reign of Kwang Shu it had extended on the West to
Bubbling Well Road and on the East to Yingziangkiang. Then
the Foreign Ministers to China decided to amalgamate the
British and American Settlements with their new extensions
and called the combined area the International Settlement.
At the present day, with the exception of the French
Concession, all other foreign concessions in Shanghai are
called International Settlements.
To a person who has never visited Shanghai or who
has not had a clear observation of it, Shanghai is regarded
as a great commercial port of the Far East and a metropolis
of the world. It is true that if we observe it physically,
the International Settlement of Shanghai is very good and
nice to look at, with its broad, clean streets, high buildings,
bright electric lights, convenient communications, perfectly
designed parks and well organized public utility services.
But when we come to study the civic administration of the
International Settlement from the basic point of municipal
administration, we find the administration of municipal
affairs in the International Settlement to be much backward.
For convenience, this study of the civic adminis-
tration of the International Settlement is divided into three
main parts, namely:- (1) Organization of the Civic Adminis-
tration, (2) Communications, and (3) Public Safety. These
three main parts may be insufficient to embody the entire
civic administration of the International Settlement, but
they will serve to give a general idea.
II. Study of the Organization of the Administrative Organ.
The system of organization of the administrative
organ of the International Settlement of Shanghai has no
counterpart in any part of the world. It is a most strange
page_data.zh:
- 2 -
光绪年间，租界向西扩展至静安寺路，向东扩展至引翔港。随后，驻华外国公使决定将英租界和美租界及其新扩展区域合并，并将合并后的区域称为公共租界。如今，除法租界外，上海所有其他外国租界均称为公共租界。
对于从未到过上海或对其没有清晰观察的人来说，上海被视为远东的一个大商业港口和世界大都市。诚然，如果从外观上观察，上海公共租界看起来非常美好，街道宽阔整洁，高楼林立，电灯明亮，交通便利，公园设计完美，公用事业组织良好。但是，当我们从市政管理的基本点来研究公共租界的市政管理时，我们发现公共租界的市政事务管理相当落后。为方便起见，本项对公共租界市政管理的研究分为三个主要部分，即：（1）市政管理机构组织，（2）交通，以及（3）公共安全。这三个主要部分可能不足以涵盖公共租界市政管理的全部内容，但足以提供一个大致的概念。
二、行政机构组织研究。
上海公共租界行政机构的组织体系在世界上任何地方都无先例。这是一种最奇怪的

page_data.en:
- 3 -
and peculiar municipal administration. The highest organ
of the civic administration is the Consular Body of foreign
Powers which is an international organization and next to
it is the Ratepayers Meeting. The authority of the Consular
Body extends only to external affairs affecting the International
Settlement, while the internal administration is under the
control of the Ratepayers Meeting. This Ratepayers Meeting
resembles a democratic rule, but the franchise is limited only
to a few foreign residents who possess real estate and who pay
a certain amount in land tax. With the exception of these
few persons, all other residents in the Settlement, regardless
of their nationality, have no office in the municipal adminis-
tration.
This peculiar municipal organization is an imitation
of the civic administration prevailing in British colonies
several hundred years ago, but during the past century the
system was abolished upon the introduction of democratic rule.
Nevertheless the municipal authorities of the International
Settlement still adopts this system. The right of the foreign
residents in the administration is secured on the amount of
rate paid, and this so-called rate is only limited to a certain
tax. Consequently only 2,000 of the foreign residents enjoy
this privilege.
All Chinese residents are debarred from this privilege.
Though there are at present five Chinese Councillors on the
S.M.C., the Chinese residents, possessing similar qualifications,
have no right to attend the Ratepayers Meeting. Chinese
residents in the International Settlement also have a "Rate-
payers Meeting" (that is the Chinese Ratepayers Association
of the International Settlement) but it is simply an organ for
the election of the five Chinese Councillors, apart from which
they have no power at all to interfere with the civic adminis-
tration of the International Settlement.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -
且奇特的市政管理。市政管理的最高机构是外国列强的领事团，这是一个国际组织，其次是纳税人会议。领事团的权力仅限于影响公共租界的外交事务，而内部管理则由纳税人会议控制。这个纳税人会议类似于民主统治，但选举权仅限于少数拥有不动产并缴纳一定数额土地税的外国居民。除了这几个人之外，租界内的所有其他居民，无论其国籍如何，在市政管理中均无职位。
这种奇特的市政组织是模仿几百年前英国殖民地盛行的市政管理，但在过去的一个世纪里，随着民主制度的引入，该制度已被废除。尽管如此，公共租界的市政当局仍然采用这一制度。外国居民在行政管理中的权利取决于所缴纳的捐税金额，而这种所谓的捐税仅限于某种特定的税收。因此，只有2,000名外国居民享有这一特权。
所有中国居民都被剥夺了这一特权。虽然目前工部局中有五名华董，但具备同等资格的中国居民无权参加纳税人会议。公共租界的中国居民也有一个“纳税人会议”（即上海公共租界华人纳税会），但这仅仅是一个选举五名华董的机构，除此之外，他们完全无权干涉公共租界的市政管理。

page_data.en:
- 4 -

III. Study of the Means of Communication.

Compared with the new system adopted by modern countries in the world, the system of communication in the International Settlement may be said to be in a very primitive stage. An obvious instance will prove this: the operation of tram cars on Chekiang Road, the railless cars on Haining Road, etc. These streets are very narrow but the S.M.C. permits the running of tram cars.

Before studying the communications service, let us examine the plan of the S.M.C. in marking off the areas into districts. This plan is very rough, no distinction being made between business and residential districts, while the industrial and educational districts lack further consideration. This shows that the S.M.C. pays no heed to such matters when marking off the areas into districts. Bubbling Well Road and its neighbourhood constitute the residential district, Nanking Road and its neighbourhood the business quarter and Ferry Road and its vicinity the industrial section.

Just as the district planning has been haphazard so can we definitely say that the system of communication has also lacked proper consideration. For the sake of convenience, the following subjects will be dealt with separately:-
(1) The street system.
(2) Width of streets.
(3) Means of communication and its control.

(1) The street system: An important point in any plan of communications is street construction. Streets are the veins of a metropolis. The unsuitability of the system and form of the street will cause obstruction to communications. The congestion of traffic in the vicinity of the Bank of England, London, and on the 5th Avenue, New York, is due to lack of fore-sight when designing the streets.
page_data.zh:
- 4 -

三、交通方式研究。

与世界现代国家采用的新系统相比，公共租界的交通系统可以说处于非常原始的阶段。一个明显的例子可以证明这一点：浙江路上的电车运行，海宁路上的无轨电车等。这些街道非常狭窄，但工部局允许电车运行。

在研究交通服务之前，让我们考察一下工部局在划分区域时的规划。该规划非常粗糙，未区分商业区和住宅区，而对工业区和教育区也缺乏进一步考虑。这表明工部局在划分区域时并未注意此类事项。静安寺路及其周边构成住宅区，南京路及其周边为商业区，斐伦路及其附近为工业区。

正如区域规划是随意的一样，我们可以肯定地说，交通系统也缺乏适当的考虑。为方便起见，以下主题将分别论述：
(1) 街道系统。
(2) 街道宽度。
(3) 交通方式及其管制。

(1) 街道系统：任何交通规划中的一个重要点是街道建设。街道是大都市的血管。街道系统和形式的不适宜会导致交通阻塞。伦敦英格兰银行附近和纽约第五大道的交通拥堵，是由于在设计街道时缺乏远见所致。

page_data.en:
- 5 -

The construction of streets in the International
Settlement has not been according to any system or form at
all. Speaking of form, it is of the old "chess" type.
There are many forms of streets, the "chess" type being the
oldest.

The following is a brief explanation of (1) the
"chess" form, (2) the "ray" form, (3) the "combined "chess"
and "ray" form, and (4) the "circle" form.

The "chess" form was formerly largely adopted in
the design of big cities, prominent among which are Tokyo,
Osaka and Nagoya of Japan. In fact this type of street
is no longer modern, yet it is still adopted by the authorities
of the International Settlement.

In the "ray" form of streets, a suitable place
should be chosen as the centre of communications. All
streets will then spread out from this centre like rays.
There is no such type of street in Shanghai.

The combined "chess" and "ray" form of streets is
the incorporation of these two forms. It does not exist
in the International Settlement.

The "circle" form is the most valuable of all forms
of communication in large modern cities. It is adopted by
the municipal authorities of Berlin, Germany.

Does not all this show that the system of
communications in the International Settlement is backward?

(2) Width of Streets. The width of streets in large modern
cities is based on the width of vehicles. The width of a
motor car ranges from 6 feet to 7 feet. When designing a
street, a car should be allowed a space of 8 feet in order
to avoid collision. Therefore, to permit two cars running
in opposite directions, each street must be at least 16 feet
in width. An additional width of 8 feet should be provided
if another car is to be allowed to park on the road and another
page_data.zh:
- 5 -

公共租界的街道建设完全没有遵循任何系统或形式。就形式而言，它属于古老的“棋盘式”。街道有许多形式，“棋盘式”是最古老的。

以下是对 (1) “棋盘式”，(2) “放射式”，(3) “棋盘式”与“放射式”结合式，以及 (4) “环形”式的简要说明。

“棋盘式”以前在大城市的设计中被广泛采用，其中日本的东京、大阪和名古屋尤为突出。事实上，这种类型的街道已不再现代，但公共租界当局仍然采用。

在“放射式”街道中，应选择一个合适的地点作为交通中心。然后所有街道将像射线一样从这个中心向外延伸。上海没有这种类型的街道。

“棋盘式”与“放射式”结合的街道是这两种形式的结合。公共租界中不存在这种形式。

“环形”式是现代大城市中所有交通形式中最有价值的。德国柏林的市政当局采用了这种形式。

这一切难道不表明公共租界的交通系统是落后的吗？

(2) 街道宽度。现代大城市的街道宽度基于车辆的宽度。汽车的宽度范围为6英尺至7英尺。在设计街道时，应为汽车预留8英尺的空间以避免碰撞。因此，为了允许两辆汽车相向行驶，每条街道的宽度至少必须为16英尺。如果允许另一辆汽车停在路边，应额外增加8英尺宽度，另一侧

page_data.en:
- 6 -

8 feet to allow another car to park on the other side of the
road. If tram tracks are constructed, 10 feet more for
single tracks and 20 feet more for double tracks should be
provided. Besides this, the two foot paths on each side of
the street will require 20 feet in all. Thus the standard
width of a street should be 80 feet at least. How many streets
in the International Settlement are of this width? Has Nanking
Road, the busiest street in the International Settlement, a
width of 80 feet? Only one section of Nanking Road is 90 feet.
The following is a list of the widest streets in the
great cities of the world:-

| Name of City | Name of Street | Width (in feet) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Paris | Si-Ah-Ah-Lee Street | 260 |
| Berlin | Wa-Ti-Loo-Li-Na Street | 190 |
| London | Ba-Ya Street | 120 |
| Hamburg | Li-Ha-Loo-Ha Street | 210 |

Recently the "Communications Investigation Committee"
of the city of London set up the following standard for the
width of streets in London:-

| Rank of Street | Width (in feet) |
| :--- | :--- |
| Big Street | 140 |
| 1st Class Street | 100 |
| 2nd " " | 80 |
| 3rd " " | 60 |
| 4th " " | 40 |

(3) Measures of Communication and Control. There are two
methods of communication in the International Settlement,
namely: tram car and omnibus.

The tram car was first introduced into the International
Settlement on August 21, 1908, when the S.M.C. concluded an
agreement with the Pu-La-Si Electric Company, a British firm.
Let us study the tram car traffic and the repeated increase in
fare, the latter being a peculiar feature of the communication
service in the International Settlement.
page_data.zh:
- 6 -

再增加8英尺以允许另一辆汽车停在路的另一边。如果铺设电车轨道，单轨需额外增加10英尺，双轨需额外增加20英尺。此外，街道两侧的人行道总共需要20英尺。因此，街道的标准宽度至少应为80英尺。公共租界中有多少条街道具有这种宽度？公共租界最繁忙的街道南京路是否有80英尺宽？南京路只有一段是90英尺。
以下是世界各大城市最宽街道的列表：

| 城市名称 | 街道名称 | 宽度（英尺） |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 巴黎 | 香榭丽舍大街 (Si-Ah-Ah-Lee Street) | 260 |
| 柏林 | 瓦特卢林纳街 (Wa-Ti-Loo-Li-Na Street) | 190 |
| 伦敦 | 巴亚街 (Ba-Ya Street) | 120 |
| 汉堡 | 利哈洛哈街 (Li-Ha-Loo-Ha Street) | 210 |

最近，伦敦市的“交通调查委员会”为伦敦街道宽度制定了以下标准：

| 街道等级 | 宽度（英尺） |
| :--- | :--- |
| 大街 | 140 |
| 一级街道 | 100 |
| 二级 " " | 80 |
| 三级 " " | 60 |
| 四级 " " | 40 |

(3) 交通措施与管制。公共租界有两种交通方式，即：电车和公共汽车。

电车于1908年8月21日首次引入公共租界，当时工部局与英国公司普拉西电气公司（Pu-La-Si Electric Company）达成协议。让我们研究一下电车交通以及票价的反复上涨，后者是公共租界交通服务的一个奇特特征。

page_data.en:
- 7 -

In most great cities, this service is operated by
the municipality and cheap fares are charged and are mostly
uniform. In the city of Boston all such services are
operated by mercantile firms, but the municipality signs an
agreement with these concerns providing that no increase in
fares will be permitted within a certain period. Not so with
the Tram Company in the International Settlement of Shanghai.
Nearly every year the company wishes to increase the fares,
and the company has not yet derived an effective remedy to
check "squeeze" by the conductors. We do not know why the
S.M.C. has not studied this question.

In many cases the running of tram cars in some
streets is unsatisfactorily, such as the operating of tram
cars or railless cars on Fokien, Chiaotung, Canton, Kaifeng
and Boone Roads which are very narrow. If a car accidentally
comes across another vehicle while turning a corner, traffic
is at once held up. In some places there is sufficient space
to allow one car to pass and should another car come from the
opposite direction, that car, if managed improperly, will be
driven into houses. It is obvious that no heed has been
paid to the width of the streets and the service is operated
on any kind of road. They ignore the safety of business shops
and residences on both sides of the street; they seem to have
no consideration for the safety of Chinese people in the
Settlement. In May 1926 a railless running to Shanghai
North Station killed a pedestrian and ran into a shop on
Fokien Road causing much damage. The resulting Court case
found the Tramway Company "not guilty". There are many other
instances of this nature. We can not say that communications
in the International Settlement have been designed for the
convenience of the citizens.

The buses in the International Settlement are operated
by the China General Omnibus Company, a British concern. It was
page_data.zh:
- 7 -

在大多数大城市中，此类服务由市政府运营，票价低廉且大多统一。在波士顿市，所有此类服务均由商业公司运营，但市政府与这些公司签订协议，规定在一定期限内不得提高票价。上海公共租界的电车公司则并非如此。该公司几乎每年都希望提高票价，且尚未找到有效的补救措施来遏制售票员的“揩油”行为。我们不知工部局为何未研究此问题。

在许多情况下，某些街道的电车运行状况令人不满，例如在福建路、交通路、广东路、开封路和布恩路（Boone Road）等非常狭窄的道路上运行有轨电车或无轨电车。如果车辆在转弯时意外碰到另一辆车，交通便会立即受阻。在某些地方，空间仅够一辆车通过，若另一辆车从对面驶来，若操作不当，该车便会撞入房屋。显然，运营方并未考虑街道宽度，而是在任何类型的道路上都开展服务。他们无视街道两侧商铺和住宅的安全；似乎也不顾及租界内中国人的安全。1926年5月，一辆开往上海北站的无轨电车轧死一名行人，并撞入福建路的一家商店，造成巨大损失。随后的法庭判决电车公司“无罪”。此类事例还有许多。我们不能说公共租界的交通设计是为了市民的便利。

公共租界的公共汽车由英商中国通用公共汽车公司（China General Omnibus Company）运营。该公司成立于

page_data.en:
- 8 -
established in 1925 and the service was commenced in 1926. But
before its inauguration it was stated that an American firm had
drawn up a plan of service but the S.M.C. refused to register it.
Subsequently the service was operated by the British firm. This
point shows the influence of the British on the S.M.C. The
reason given by the S.M.C. in rejecting the American plan was
that the streets of the Settlement were too narrow and unsuitable
for the operation of buses and that the transportation by tram
car was convenient. Yet the plan of the British firm was
unconditionally accepted!

These two transportation companies hold great power
in transportation matters in the International Settlement. Our
dissatisfaction with them lies in the fact that their sole care
appears to make profits, the consideration of the citizen being
relegated to the background. The S.M.C. cannot restrict their
free action in increasing fares. This shows that the authorities
of the International Settlement cannot place restrictions on
industrial concerns. Therefore, we can hardly say that
communications are being controlled by the S.M.C. in conformity
with the principles taught by Civic Administration Science.

IV. Study of Public Safety Institutions.

The object of a Public Safety Institution is to
safeguard the life and property of the citizens of the district
and at the same time to assure the security of the citizen who
walks on the street. Hence every municipal organ has its
Public Safety Bureau. The public safety affairs in the
International Settlement are undertaken by Police Station.

The Police Station in the International Settlement
is the same as the Public Safety Bureau of the Municipality of
Greater Shanghai. Policemen posted to various streets to control
traffic are called traffic policemen (they direct the traffic and
handle the signal lights). Those who patrol the streets are
generally called policemen.
page_data.zh:
- 8 -
1925年，服务于1926年开始运营。但在其开业之前，据称一家美国公司已制定了一份服务计划，但工部局拒绝注册。随后，该服务由这家英国公司运营。这一点显示了英国人对工部局的影响。工部局拒绝美国计划的理由是，租界的街道太窄，不适合公共汽车运营，而有轨电车交通更为便利。然而，英国公司的计划却被无条件接受了！

这两家运输公司在公共租界的交通事务中拥有巨大的权力。我们对它们的不满在于，它们似乎只关心利润，而将市民的考量置于次要地位。工部局无法限制它们随意提高票价。这表明公共租界当局无法对工业企业施加限制。因此，我们很难说交通管理是工部局按照市政管理科学所教导的原则进行控制的。

四、公共安全机构研究。

公共安全机构的目的是保护该地区市民的生命和财产，同时确保行人在街道上的安全。因此，每个市政机关都设有公共安全局。公共租界的公共安全事务由警察局承担。

公共租界的警察局与大上海市政府的公共安全局相同。派驻各街道控制交通的警察称为交通警察（他们指挥交通并操作信号灯）。在街道上巡逻的人通常称为警察。

page_data.en:
- 9 -

We append a study of the relations between the
traffic policemen, the policemen and the security of the
citizens:-

Traffic signal lights are being gradually installed
at various important road intersections in the International
Settlement, yet motor car accidents are still on the increase.
This may be attributed to the following causes:-

(a) Lack of practical training on the part of drivers.
(b) Carelessness in issuing drivers' licences. (In every big
city of Germany, a driver must undergo a rigorous
examination and can secure a licence only after passing
the test).
(c) No fixed speed rate. (The speed rate should be clearly
marked at various road crossings).
(d) Lack of signs from a motor car. (Most cars do not give
any sign when turning a corner - the only sign is a hand
sign made by the driver).

These four causes have reduced the security of the
citizen on the streets. According to a report in the Shanghai
Evening Post & Mercury, the number of car accidents for the
month of October as recorded by the Traffic Office of the
Shanghai Municipal Police is 1,279, in which 20 persons were
killed and 448 were injured. Motor cars caused 1,017 of these
accidents, in which 13 persons were killed and 296 were injured.
In tram car accidents, 3 persons were killed and 36 persons
injured, while in bus accidents, 3 persons were killed and
18 persons injured. According to this estimate, the number
of people killed in traffic accidents for one year must be
about 240, which number cannot be said to be negligible.

Whether or not there are any omissions in the
statistics compiled by the Traffic Office is not known, because
many cars, after causing an accident, immediately settle the
trouble privately, while many others made good their escape
page_data.zh:
- 9 -

我们附上关于交通警察、警察与市民安全之间关系的研究：-

公共租界各重要路口正在逐步安装交通信号灯，但汽车事故仍在增加。这可归因于以下原因：-

(a) 司机缺乏实际训练。
(b) 颁发驾驶执照时疏忽大意。（在德国每个大城市，司机必须经过严格考试，只有通过测试才能获得执照）。
(c) 没有固定的速度限制。（应在各路口清晰标明速度限制）。
(d) 汽车缺乏信号指示。（大多数汽车在转弯时不给任何信号——唯一的信号是司机做出的手势）。

这四个原因降低了市民在街道上的安全性。根据《上海晚邮报与水星报》（Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury）的报道，上海公共租界警务处交通科记录的10月份汽车事故数量为1,279起，其中20人死亡，448人受伤。汽车造成了其中的1,017起事故，导致13人死亡，296人受伤。在有轨电车事故中，3人死亡，36人受伤；而在公共汽车事故中，3人死亡，18人受伤。据此估算，一年中死于交通事故的人数约为240人，这一数字不可谓不小。

交通科编制的统计数据是否有遗漏尚不清楚，因为许多汽车在造成事故后立即私下解决纠纷，而另有许多汽车

page_data.en:
- 10 -
because the accident had not been witnessed by any traffic
policeman. All this is due to a lack of proper measures
to solve the question of traffic control. Can anybody say
that the streets of the International Settlement are not like
the "tiger's horrible mouth"?

There are many instances in which policemen while
pursuing criminals have killed innocent citizens. We often
see a policeman, while searching pedestrians, hold his pistol
as if about to fire while two other policemen are conducting
the search. Naturally it is their duty and they have to
perform it, but there have been many instances in which they
have indiscreetly opened fire. We now quote an instance of
indiscreet shooting by policemen while pursuing robbers resulting
in the killing of innocent people. On August 28, 1929, a man
walking near the corner of Thibet and Foochow Roads was pointed
out as a robber, and the man together with other innocent people
were shot dead. The alleged robber had been pointed out by a
Chinese youngster. The "China Weekly Review" (August 31, 1929)
published the following criticism (this translation has been
adopted in the Settlement Restoration Movement of the Central
Propaganda Department of the Chinese Kuomintang Party):-

"......... Thus another sanguinary, utterly
unnecessary, brutal and murderous attack is entered in the
annals of the Shanghai Municipal Police. Seven pedestrians
wounded to kill one possible criminal, the guilt of whom was
established by the testimony of a Chinese youngster! Such
outrageous inefficiency could not go unchallenged in any other
city in the world! It is a condition peculiar to Shanghai -
this total disregard of the value of innocent human lives, this
quaint custom of the local police in using law-observing citizens
for target practice! A constable who cannot handle a gun with
any more accuracy than these guilty imbeciles ought to be given
a club only after an admonishment to use it with extreme care
and in case of greatest urgency."
page_data.zh:
- 10 -
因事故未被任何交通警察目击而逃脱。这一切都是由于缺乏解决交通管制问题的适当措施。谁能说公共租界的街道不像“虎口”那样可怕呢？

有许多案例显示，警察在追捕罪犯时杀害了无辜市民。我们经常看到一名警察在搜查行人时手持手枪，仿佛准备射击，而另外两名警察正在进行搜查。这自然是他们的职责，他们必须履行，但已有许多案例显示他们轻率地开枪。现在我们引用一例警察在追捕强盗时轻率开枪导致无辜者死亡的事件。1929年8月28日，一名在西藏路与福州路拐角附近行走的男子被指认为强盗，该男子与其他无辜者一同被枪杀。所谓的强盗是由一名中国少年指认的。《密勒氏评论报》（China Weekly Review，1929年8月31日）发表了以下批评（此译文已被中国国民党中央宣传部在收回租界运动中采用）：-

“......... 因此，上海公共租界警务处的历史上又记录了一次血腥、完全不必要的、残忍且充满杀意的攻击。为了杀死一名可能的罪犯而打伤七名行人，而该罪犯的罪名仅由一名中国少年的证词确立！这种 outrageous 的低效在世界任何其他城市都不会不被挑战！这是上海特有的状况——完全无视无辜人类生命的价值，这是当地警察将守法公民当作射击靶子的奇特习俗！一名不能比这些有罪的蠢货更准确使用枪支的警员，在受到告诫要极其小心并在最紧急情况下使用后，只应配发警棍。”

page_data.en:
- 11 -

"Had any one of the victims of the outrage been a
foreigner we may be assured that the S.M.P. would back-track
at once from the appallingly insouciant and criminal attitude
'shoot to kill, and bother the bystanders!' which apparently
prevails among its British, White Russian and Chinese mercenaries.
But the seven were 'only some Chinese coolies' - and thus
constitute a matter of no importance to the local authorities.
Such mental stupidity as displayed by these members of the
British-controlled and British-trained police not only leaves
darker stains on that already badly soiled department,
incompetent and ruthless, but also reflects seriously on the
ability of the entire Shanghai governing body, peculiar and
unparalleled in its autocratic structure!"

V.- Conclusion.

There are more several other things about the
administration of the International Settlement which we wish
to study, but the afore-mentioned three portions are the most
important and will suffice for the present.

The concentration of the people in the International
Settlement and the prosperity of the Settlement are in direct
relation as cause is to effect. If considered physically, the
prosperity of the International Settlement would appear to be
the result of their energy. As a matter of fact, such an
idea is erroneous. Why? We have seen that during the civil
wars in China in the past 20 years and in the strife between
the new and old warlords, many people from various places took
refuge in the Settlement. It is often the case that after a
civil war the population in the International Settlement is
greatly increased. This clearly shows that it is the warlords
of China who are directly and indirectly responsible for the
prosperity of the International Settlement.

Furthermore the warlords, corrupt officials and wicked
gentry of China, having enriched themselves with money extorted
page_data.zh:
- 11 -

“如果这次暴行的任何一名受害者是外国人，我们可以确信，公共租界警务处会立即从其在其英国、白俄和中国雇佣兵中显然盛行的‘见人就射，不管旁观者’这一令人震惊的冷漠和犯罪态度上退却。但这七人‘只是一些中国苦力’——因此对当地当局来说无关紧要。这些受英国控制和训练的警察成员所表现出的这种精神愚钝，不仅给那个已经污迹斑斑、无能且残忍的部门抹上了更黑的污点，也严重反映了整个上海统治机构的能力，其专制结构独特且无与伦比！”

五、结论。

关于公共租界的行政管理，还有几件事我们希望研究，但前述三个部分最为重要，目前足以说明问题。

公共租界的人口集中与租界的繁荣之间存在直接的因果关系。如果从物理角度考虑，公共租界的繁荣似乎是人们精力的结果。事实上，这种想法是错误的。为什么？我们看到，在过去20年的中国内战以及新旧军阀的争斗中，各地许多人避难进入租界。通常情况下，内战后公共租界的人口会大幅增加。这清楚地表明，是中国的军阀直接或间接地对公共租界的繁荣负责。

此外，中国的军阀、贪官和劣绅，用从内地城镇人民那里勒索来的钱致富后，来到上海，在公共租界建造别墅，在那里安居乐业。这也是促成租界繁荣的原因之一。

一个独立的国家必须拥有其主权领土和权利的完整性。如果一个独立国家的主权领土上存在租界（我们并非特指上海租界），那么这个国家根本就不是一个独立的国家。

我们将“租界”一词定义如下：“租界是外国在中国自行管理其法律的土地；换句话说，是由于治外法权而使中国主权受到限制的土地”。

租界存在于那些人民视外国人为异族的半孤立国家中。中国是唯一存在租界的国家。然而，我们的同胞仍将这租界视为天堂。国家的主权在哪里？我提及这些事是为了让我的同胞知晓。

page_data.en:

from the people of inland towns, come to Shanghai and build
their villas in the International Settlement where they live
in peace. This is also one of the causes contributing to
the prosperity of the Settlement.

An independent country must possess integrity of
its sovereign lands and rights. If there exists a settlement
(we are not referring specially to the Settlement of Shanghai)
in the sovereign land of an independent state, then this nation
is not an independent country at all.

We have defined the word "Settlement" as follows:-
"A settlement is territory in which foreign countries administer
their own laws in China; in other words, it is territory where
the sovereignty of China is restricted by reason of extra-
territoriality".

A settlement exists in semi-isolated countries whose
people regard foreigners as tribes. China is the only country
wherein Settlements exist. Nevertheless our countrymen still
regard these Settlements as paradise. Where is the sovereignty
of the nation? I mention these things for the information of
my countrymen.
page_data.zh:

来自内地城镇的民众来到上海，在公共租界内建造他们的别墅，并在此安居乐业。这也是促成租界繁荣的原因之一。

一个独立的国家必须拥有其主权领土和权利的完整性。如果一个独立国家的主权领土内存在租界（我们并非特指上海租界），那么这个国家就根本不是一个独立的国家。

我们将“租界”一词定义如下：“租界是指外国在中国施行其本国法律的地区；换言之，是因治外法权而导致中国主权受到限制的地区”。

租界存在于那些视外国人为异族的半孤立国家中。中国是唯一存在租界的国家。然而，我们的同胞仍将这些租界视为天堂。国家的主权何在？我提及这些事项，旨在供我国同胞知悉。
